stem_book: If force acting on an object of mass 1 kg varies as f = 6x − 5 and velocity varies as v = 3t² + 4t + 3, then linear momentum will vary with time as (At t = 0, F = 7 N) (a) P = (3/2)t⁴ + 4t³ + 9t² − 5t (b) P = (3/2)t⁴ + 4t³ + 9t² + 7t (c) P = (3/2)t⁴ + 4t³ + 9t² + 7t + 3 (d) P = (3/2)t⁴ + 4t³ + 9t² − 5t + 3
reason: Self-contradictory data: with m = 1 kg, p = mv = 3t² + 4t + 3 (and F = dv/dt = 6t + 4 ≠ 6x − 5); intended route gives (c) but no option equals mv.
